_comment: DOWNLOADABLE (remote) curriculum packs -- for content NOT shipped in this repo. DORMANT as of R10: every authored pack now ships in-repo under curriculum/templates/ and is toggled on/off locally (see web/app.py's /settings/curricula routes), so nothing is download-gated today. The R8 fetch machinery (HTTPS against a PINNED base URL, sha256 verified before any write -- see web/app.py's curriculum_packs/install routes) is kept for a genuine future need: community-contributed packs, or a library too large to ship by default. Add an entry here ONLY for a pack whose source genuinely is NOT in this repo. Format per entry: {id, dir, label, description, licence, files:[{name, sha256}]}.
